youtube.baslik: When does the inner ear begin to form? #shorts
youtube.aciklama: The inner ear is the first part of the ear to develop: at the end of the third week, around day 22, the otic placode appears. This happens in the first month of pregnancy, often before the mother even knows she is pregnant. By the end of the eighth week, the cochlear duct makes about two and a half turns, and the cochlea begins to function at around the twentieth week; the weeks are approximate.
